power_filter: |power| >= median |power| among FDR-significant targets; nonzero power
selection_test: two-sided paired samples t-test (scipy.stats.ttest_rel, baseline vs IKZF2-zero per cell); BH
zero_variance_rule: identical predictions p=1; constant nonzero shift p=0
interpretation: Model response associations, not direct or causal GRN. Matched cell predictions are not independent biological replicates.
